scope: Read-only review of local firmware pack/sign gate; no signing, networking, flash or hardware operation by reviewer
reviewed: Exact stock outer FIT/model/config image set, stock inner signature verification and pinned public key identity
BSP LZO decoder source pinned and exact new/stock kernel round trips
Only kernel+rootfs payload replacement; nonkernel boot payloads compared byte for byte; no loader update
Rootfs and kernel hashes bound to staged inventory and exact QEMU cpio rootfs bytes plus userspace SHA list
QEMU hash/log/required marker/container/module evidence; no network or host block devices
Candidate guardian receipt identity/source/evidence/deployment gate checks and immutable stage inventory match
Explicit if-not-__debug__ rejects Python optimized mode before assert-dependent checks

findings.detail: Explicit RuntimeError on optimized mode prevents -O/PYTHONOPTIMIZE from bypassing assertion-based gates.

limitations: Review does not prove BCM bootloader acceptance, physical watchdog/reset, or ASUS hardware functionality.
No gate-enabled guardian or final stage QEMU was accepted by this review; actual matching evidence is required at invocation.
